text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I visited the gym, two horse girls were running on the treadmills.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haah—!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...
Whew, whew, whew...

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
—Oh?
Good work, Shion-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah... Verxina-san. You've got some incredible presence going on.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It feels like you're wringing out even more power than usual... Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: —, Well...

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
...No, I suppose I can tell you, Shion-san.
To be honest—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Hardworking Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way, at that speed and over that distance...!?
Isn't that a new record...!?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had begun running.
...In order to surpass that record.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
――――
Same here...

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I heard Orfe-san set a new record.
I couldn't just stand by and do nothing, so...

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: My. ...That is—

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Neither of us can afford to slack off, can we?
Considering who our rivals are.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but—I will do it!
Without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Two horse girls facing overwhelming rivals. Each started running to overcome their fated nemesis—!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hmph, hmph—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both steadily increased their speed and distance, breathing heavier with every passing second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They were pushing their limits so hard it made me worry they might overexert themselves.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should say something to them—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: DAAAAAAHHHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, haa...
I beat it....!!!!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
!
You too, Shion-san?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Eh, you as well, Verxina-san?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Fufufu!
—Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it?
...I feel as if a weight has been lifted off my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It feels like I can walk with my head held a bit higher than usual.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —We might meet again like this, won't we?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
And when we do, surely—

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
We will do the exact same thing.
Each striving to surpass our own wall.
